edges.carries: the reference to last month's bill payment record
the payee and amount paid last month
the payee and amount this month's bill states
the payee and amount to pay, when they match last month
the payee and amount that differ from last month, when they do not match

nodes.name: FindLastMonthBill
nodes.role: locate last month's bill that the user paid, to identify the payee and amount

nodes.name: ReadPriorPayment
nodes.role: read the payee and amount from last month's bill payment record

nodes.name: FetchCurrentBill
nodes.role: retrieve this month's bill from the user's billing account

nodes.name: CheckBillMatchesPrior
nodes.role: compare this month's bill payee and amount with last month's payment record

nodes.name: PayBill
nodes.role: pay the amount this month's bill states to its payee

nodes.name: ConfirmPayment
nodes.role: record and report the completed payment to the user

nodes.name: FlagForUserReview
nodes.role: notify the user that this month's bill differs from last month's and hold payment
